questions.question: In Filmfare OTT Awards 2025, which title won Best Web Original Film?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Girls Will Be Girls.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Girls Will Be Girls won Best Web Original Film at Filmfare OTT Awards 2025.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Best Web Original Film winner listed is Girls Will Be Girls.**
 
• **The platform listed for the film is Prime Video.**
 
• **Shuchi Talati won Best Director (Film) for Girls Will Be Girls.**
 
• **Preeti Panigrahi won Best Actor (Female – Critics) for Girls Will Be Girls.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Web Original Film__

 __
 
• This category covers feature-length films released directly on streaming platforms.
 
• In 2025, Girls Will Be Girls (Prime Video) is listed as Best Web Original Film.
 
 
 
• Film Categories vs Series Categories__
 
 
• Filmfare OTT Awards separate awards for series (episodes/season-based) and web original films (standalone films).
 
• Girls Will Be Girls appears under the Web Original Film section in the 2025 winner list.

questions.question: Who won the World Athlete of the Year (Men) award at the 2025 World Athletics Awards?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Armand Duplantis**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Armand Duplantis of Sweden and Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone of the USA won the World Athlete of the Year awards at the 2025 World Athletics Awards.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• **Armand Duplantis won the Men’s World Athlete of the Year award for his extraordinary 2025 season.**
 
• **He broke the men’s pole vault world record four times and remained undefeated in all 16 events.**
 
• **Duplantis became the first male pole vaulter in modern athletics to stay unbeaten for two consecutive years.**
 
• **He also won both indoor and outdoor world titles, earning the Men’s Field Athlete of the Year honour as well.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sydney McLaughlin-Levrone**__

 __
 
• Won Women’s World Athlete of the Year 2025.
 
• Won the 400m world title in Tokyo with a record 47.78 seconds.
 
• Became the first athlete to win world titles in both 400m flat and 400m hurdles.
 
• Awarded Women’s Track Athlete of the Year.
 
 
 
• **Other Award Winners**__
 __
 
• Maria Perez (Spain) – Women’s Out-of-Stadium Athlete of the Year.
 
• Sebastian Sawe (Kenya) – Men’s Out-of-Stadium Athlete of the Year.
 
• Emmanuel Wanyonyi (Kenya) – Men’s Track Athlete of the Year.
 
• Nicola Olyslagers (Australia) – Women’s Field Athlete of the Year.
 
 
 
• **Rising Star Awards**__
 __
 
• Edmund Serem (Kenya) – Male Rising Star.
 
• Zhang Jiale (China) – Female Rising Star.
 
 
 
• **Event Significance**__
 
 
• Reflects a year filled with global talent, historic achievements, and record-breaking performances.
 
• Highlights dominance in pole vault, sprints, hurdles, and endurance categories.

questions.question: Which Indian film won the Best Film Award at the Asian Film Awards 2025?

The correct answer is __**All We Imagine As Light**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Asian Film Awards** is a prestigious award ceremony that recognizes excellence in cinema across the Asian continent.
 
• The **2025 Asian Film Awards** celebrated films that showcased exceptional storytelling, direction, and performances.
 
• The film **All We Imagine As Light** won the **Best Film Award** at the 2025 Asian Film Awards. This recognition marked a significant achievement for Indian cinema.
 
• **All We Imagine As Light** is a critically acclaimed Indian film that delves into complex human emotions, relationships, and societal issues.
 
• The film stood out among other nominees like **The Disciple**, **The White Tiger**, and **Gully Boy**, which are also notable works of Indian cinema, but they did not win the award in 2025.
 
• The award reflects the growing global recognition of **Indian filmmakers** and their ability to present stories that resonate universally.
 
• ***Hence, the correct answer is All We Imagine As Light.***

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__

• The **Asian Film Awards** were established in **2007** to honor outstanding achievements in Asian cinema. The awards are presented annually by the **Asian Film Awards Academy**.
 
• The awards cover diverse categories such as **Best Film, Best Director, Best Actor, Best Actress, and technical awards**, recognizing the entire spectrum of filmmaking.
 
 
 
• **Details about All We Imagine As Light:**
 
 
• **All We Imagine As Light** is a thought-provoking film that explores themes of **identity, human connections, and resilience**.
 
• The film received critical acclaim for its **compelling narrative, stunning cinematography, and powerful performances**.
 
• It represents the evolving landscape of **Indian cinema**, which is increasingly addressing universal themes while retaining its unique cultural essence.
 
 
 
• **Other Nominees:**
 
 
• **The Disciple:** Directed by **Chaitanya Tamhane**, this film explores the life of a classical musician. It received global recognition but did not win the 2025 award.
 
• **The White Tiger:** A film adaptation of **Aravind Adiga's novel**, highlighting themes of social inequality in India.
 
• **Gully Boy:** A musical drama inspired by the lives of Indian street rappers, directed by **Zoya Akhtar**.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Significance of Asian Film Awards:**

 
 
• These awards promote cultural exchange and encourage collaboration among Asian filmmakers.
 
• They provide a platform to showcase the richness and diversity of **Asian cinema** on a global stage.
 
 
 
• **Indian Cinema's Global Recognition:**

questions.question: Who won the Abel Prize in 2025 for contributions to algebraic analysis and representation theory?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Masaki Kashiwara.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Masaki Kashiwara was awarded the **Abel Prize 2025** for his pioneering work in algebraic analysis and representation theory.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

__
 
• Kashiwara pioneered the **theory of D-modules**, an algebraic framework for studying linear partial differential equations (PDEs).
 
• He developed key tools like **microsupport** and **characteristic varieties** to study the propagation of singularities in equations.
 
• His work on **sheaf theory** deepened the understanding of the connection between local analytical data and global geometric structure.
 
• The **Abel Prize** is an international award given for outstanding work in mathematics, often considered equivalent to a Nobel Prize for mathematicians.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Abel Prize**__: A prestigious mathematics award established by the Norwegian Parliament in 2002 and first awarded in 2003, named after Niels Henrik Abel.
 
• __**D-modules**__: Algebraic structures that provide a framework for studying systems of linear partial differential equations.
 
• __**Sheaf theory**__: A branch of mathematics used to study local-global phenomena, often in topology and algebraic geometry.
 
• __**Microsupport**__: A tool in Kashiwara’s work that helps analyze the propagation of singularities in differential equations.

questions.question: The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for the discoveries concerning _______________________________.

options.text: Peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells
Understanding of IPEX syndrome in gene therapy
The role of central tolerance in the thymus

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **The 2025 Nobel Prize in Physiology or Medicine was awarded for discoveries concerning peripheral immune tolerance and regulatory T cells (Tregs).**

 
 
• Shimon Sakaguchi's 1995 discovery revealed regulatory T cells (Tregs) as key players in immune tolerance, challenging previous beliefs.
 
• Mary E. Brunkow and Fred Ramsdell's 2001 discovery of the FOXP3 gene was pivotal in understanding Treg function and its link to autoimmune diseases like IPEX syndrome.
 
• The work has significantly advanced our understanding of autoimmune diseases, cancer immunotherapy, and organ transplant success.
 
• Treg dysfunction can lead to autoimmune diseases, while excessive Treg activity can suppress the immune response against tumors in cancer.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• The*** 2025 Nobel Prizes ***were awarded across five categories, highlighting achievements in quantum physics, materials science, immunology, literature, and peace.

 
 
• **Physics Prize:**

 
 
• Awarded to** John Clarke, Michel H. Devoret, and John M. Martinis** for their work in **macroscopic quantum mechanical tunneling and energy quantization in electric circuits**, showcasing quantum mechanics at a macroscopic scale.
 
• Their work enabled advances in quantum computing, cryptography, and quantum sensors.
 
 
 
• **Chemistry Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to** Susumu Kitagawa, Richard Robson, and Omar M. Yaghi** for their development of **metal-organic frameworks (MOFs), materials with vast internal surface areas** for various applications such as water harvesting, carbon capture, and toxic gas storage.
 
 
 
• **Literature Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to L**ászló Krasznahorkai **for his** visionary works, including "Satantango**", which explore themes of apocalyptic terror, chaos, and human isolation.
 
• Known for long, complex sentences and dark, philosophical narratives.
 
 
 
• **Peace Prize:**
 
 
• Awarded to **Maria Corina Machado**, a** Venezuelan leader **and symbol of democratic resistance against authoritarianism in Venezuela, emphasizing "ballots over bullets" and leading the opposition.
 
• Praised for her courage despite life-threatening risks and for unifying the opposition around democratic principles.
 
 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Geographical Distribution:**

 
 
• United States leads with six laureates.
 
• Other countries: Japan (2 laureates), Australia, Hungary, and Venezuela (1 laureate each).
 
 
 
• **Ceremony:** 
 
 
• The award ceremony will take place on December 10, 2025, in Stockholm (Peace Prize in Oslo).
 
• Each prize includes 11 million Swedish kronor, a gold medal, and a diploma.

questions.question: Who received the 43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award?
questions.solution:
The Correct Answer is __**Nitin Gadkari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• Union Minister Gadkari honoured with 43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• 
 
**Union Minister Nitin Gadkari** was honoured with the **43rd Lokmanya Tilak National Award** in **Pune**.

 
 
• 
 
The award is presented by the **Lokmanya Tilak Smarak Trust** for **significant contributions to national progress**.

 
 
• 
 
The award includes a **cash prize of ₹1 lakh** and a **citation**.

 
 
• 
 
It was **instituted in 1983** by the **Tilak Smarak Mandir Trust** to honour **Bal Gangadhar Tilak**, also known as **Lokmanya Tilak**.

 
 
• 
 
It is presented **every year on August 1**, the **death anniversary of Tilak**.

 
 
• 
 
The **42nd recipient** (2024) was **Sudha Murty** – for contributions in **rural development, literature, and social work**.

 
 
• 
 
**PM Narendra Modi** received it before Murty for **exceptional leadership and patriotism**.

 
 
• 
 
Other past recipients include:
 **Pranab Mukherjee, Atal Bihari Vajpayee, Indira Gandhi, Manmohan Singh, Sharad Pawar, Rahul Bajaj, Cyrus Poonawalla, Verghese Kurien, M.S. Swaminathan, Sheila Dikshit, Tessy Thomas**, and others.
